name: agent-tree
description: Side pane that shows running subagents and workflows as a live tree

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: How the Agents pane looks: minimal (plain glyphs, any terminal), kitty (emoji cats), fish (lake blues, a catch) or dog (golden tan, dogs on walks)

ai.title: AI help
ai.description: What the Agents pane may ask a model to write: off (no model calls), cheap (Haiku writes reports, titles and story steps) or full (also Sonnet on demand: e explains a run, g finds patterns in History)
